  "phoneNote": "The oversized '17.00' pushes the pool photo almost completely below the fold on mobile, leaving only a thin sliver visible above the sticky bar.",
  "desktopNote": "Sharp, memorable design with clever swimming-themed graphic details (lane-rope divider and pool-lane T-lines), though the schedule and location facts are repeated too many times down the page.",

    "impression": 5,
    "hierarchy": 5,

    "spacing": 5,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Slightly reduce the font size of '17.00' and tighten vertical margins on the mobile hero so a meaningful portion of the pool photo is visible on the first screen.",
    "Remove the redundant 'Kdaj poteka vadba?' and 'Kje poteka vadba?' items from the FAQ section, as those exact facts are already prominently stated in the hero and the key-facts table.",
    "Consolidate the contact tables so the phone number and pool address are not listed twice in identical tabular formats below the fold."
  ]
}
